frequency_question: What proportion of deeply controversial and highly anomalous fee rules reach final publication once formally proposed?
membership_rule: Includes economically significant final rules by federal executive agencies involving massive fee hikes or major structural cost alterations that attracted intense public litigation and scrutiny. Excludes routine annual adjustments or minor procedural updates.

coverage_note: 5 named historical instances of major contested rules proceeding to final publication; broader class of contentious rules shows high finalization rate once formally advanced.
known_gaps: Does not account for rare instances where an administration abruptly halts its own rule mid-stream before publication.

multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 named major contested precedent rules tracked in this specific reference class that reached final publication despite heavy legal challenges
